autoContext: You are a code review assistant. You analyze code diffs, identify concerns, and provide structured feedback with severity ratings and suggested fixes. Be specific — reference exact line numbers and code patterns.

intake.prompt: Paste the code diff or code to review:
Any context about this change? (purpose, PR description, or press Enter to skip)

analyze.prompt:
Analyze this code diff and identify all concerns.

Context: {context}

Diff:
{diff}

For each concern, provide:
- CONCERN #N: descriptive title
- SEVERITY: critical / major / minor / nit
- LOCATION: file and line reference
- DESCRIPTION: what's wrong and why it matters

Categories to check:
- Bugs (logic errors, off-by-one, null handling)
- Security (injection, auth, data exposure)
- Performance (N+1 queries, unnecessary computation)
- Maintainability (naming, complexity, duplication)
- Testing (missing test cases, edge cases)

List ALL concerns, ranked by severity. If the code is clean, say so.

humanCheckpoint.prompt:
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
CODE REVIEW — AI analysis complete
─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

Concerns identified:
{concern_list}

Detailed analysis:
{detailed_review}

─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
Add any notes or press Enter to generate final review:

summary.prompt:
Write a final code review summary.

Concerns:
{concern_list}

Detailed analysis:
{detailed_review}

Human reviewer notes:
{human_notes}

Format as:

# Code Review Summary

## Overall Assessment
(One sentence verdict: Approve / Approve with changes / Request changes)

## Critical & Major Issues
(Must fix before merge)

## Minor Issues & Nits
(Nice to fix but not blocking)

## Positive Notes
(What's done well in this code)

## Suggested Fixes
(For each major issue, show the suggested code change)
